headline: Compute moves to orbit. Maritime gets coverage. China ships.
deck: Three quiet shifts this week — none of them launches, all of them re-rate part of the value chain.

stories.head: The constellation cohort just discovered orbital data centres
stories.body: Pixxel announced a pathfinder testing orbital data centre tech for geospatial intelligence. Space42 reported its systems saved 660+ lives across 25 distress events in 2025. SpaceNews ran a feature on 'riding the orbital data centre wave.' All in the same news window. The pitch is no longer 'we make satellites' — it's 'we provide compute, and the satellite happens to be the form factor.'
stories.soWhat: Compute is the next 'where is the value' question for the LEO cohort. Vertical integration, not just operational efficiency.

stories.head: Direct-to-smartphone is bleeding into maritime
stories.body: Eutelsat and Station Satcom signed a multi-year deal to scale OneWeb LEO services across Indian maritime fleets. SpaceNews ran a piece on hybrid constellations bringing imagery and comms 'under one roof.' Together they signal that the line between space and terrestrial connectivity is blurring in places — like blue-water shipping — that used to be VSAT-only.
stories.soWhat: Maritime SATCOM operators are about to get a re-rate, in either direction. Watch the contract churn.

stories.head: China's commercial launch cohort keeps printing
stories.body: Nayuta Space closed consecutive Pre-A rounds for an unconventional aerodynamic-recovery rocket. DARPA Director Stephen Winchell separately said the agency must 'harness the commercial space boom' and is exploring cislunar navigation. The Western and Chinese commercial-launch ecosystems are widening their gap, but only one side talks about it openly.
stories.soWhat: The next launch decade will not be a one-bloc story. Investment frameworks built on that assumption need to update.

watchlist.title: Anduril's IPO timing
watchlist.body: Defense-tech window still depends on a single-company print. The next 90 days remain the question.

watchlist.title: Orbital data centre RFI activity
watchlist.body: When the first government RFI lands, the cohort already shipping pathfinders takes the lead. Watch for it.

watchlist.title: Maritime SATCOM contract churn
watchlist.body: Eutelsat–Station Satcom is the first signed regional deal of its kind this quarter. Watch which fleet operator signs next.

watchlist.title: ASTS execution risk
watchlist.body: Bull case is hard to argue against on technology — execution remains the entire question.

talent.statLabel: Week-over-week growth in resumes from primes to Series B/C
talent.head: Talent is leaving big-aero — and it's not about money
talent.body: Compensation is not the gating factor. The complaint, almost universally, is schedule risk — the inability to ship anything quickly, the half-decade gap between joining and seeing flight hardware, the meeting that exists to schedule the meeting. The startups absorbing this talent will, in two years, be hard to compete with on a level playing field.
